tei:div.tei:p: )gdod nas dag pa chos kyi sku// 'khrul bral stong nyid dbyings kyi ngang*// kun bzang bla ma padma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog /nang gi bar chad nang du zhi// gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su dengs// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// gsal mdangs chen po longs spyod rdzogs// bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*// yi dam bla ma padma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog /nang gi bar chad nang du zhi// gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su dengs// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// sna tshogs 'dzin bral sprul pa'i sku// gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i ngang*// mkha' 'gro'i bla ma padma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog /nang gi bar chad nang du zhi// gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su dengs// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo nyid// rtsa gsum kun 'dus thugs rje can// rtsa ba'i bla ma padma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog /nang gi bar chad nang du zhi// gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su dengs// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// rtsa bar brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// khyad par sngags bdag ma mo la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru zlog /nang gi bar chad nang du zhi// gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su dengs// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// deng nas byang chub mchog gi bar// 'bral med rjes su bzung ba dang*// rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad zhi ba dang*// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/

zhes pa'i bar chad lam sel 'di'ang gnyer pa o rgyan skal bzang dbus su khri 'bul 'gro khar nang nub bar chad sel ba'i gsol 'debs zhig dgos shes bskul ngor/ ldem shul 'ba' rab sgar du stag sham pas bris pa don ldan du gyur cig// /
